Clean institution names

Source: R/institutions_clean.R
institutions_clean.Rd

Gives each institution one name in `AU_UN` and returns the data frame, ready for bibliometrix. Institutions are identified by their OpenAlex institution ID: for every paper with a DOI, OpenAlex says which institutions its authors belong to.

The confirmed steps, applied with no review: 1. **OpenAlex ID**: the institutions OpenAlex links to a paper's authors, under OpenAlex's name. Two institutions OpenAlex keeps apart that share a name get their country code (`NORTHEASTERN UNIVERSITY, US`, `NORTHEASTERN UNIVERSITY, CN`). 2. **Address OpenAlex linked**: an address OpenAlex linked to one institution on any paper gets that institution on every paper (`source` `openalex address`). 3. **OpenAlex name**: otherwise the institution part of the address is taken (the part naming a university, college, academy or hospital, else an institute, centre, lab or company, else the first part); if it is the name of one institution OpenAlex knows, accents lost or not, it is that institution (`openalex name`). 4. **Address**: otherwise that part is kept as written, cleaned as [keywords_clean()] cleans keywords, your `replace` tables applied, and names written differently (case, punctuation, accents, spaces, plural) made one. A name that becomes an identified institution's name joins it.

Papers OpenAlex does not cover, and authors it gives only an address for, go through steps 2 to 4. Two institutions OpenAlex identified are never merged.

OpenAlex's answers are kept in `cache`, so a second run, or a run that stopped, asks only for the papers not asked yet. Requests run ten at a time, at most ten a second (OpenAlex's limit), 100 DOIs each.

`level = "all"` merges nothing: it returns `data` unchanged and writes every merge to the `decisions` sheet, for a person or a model to check outside R, with a short prompt beside it, as [keywords_clean()] does. The sheet has one group per `name` (the institution the group becomes): its `confirmed` merges (steps 2 to 4) and its `needs_revision` candidates, found as [keywords_clean()] finds them (`source`: `spelling`, `word order`, `ngram`, `stem`, `initials`). An identified institution is always the `name` of its group. Only institutions in at least `min_papers` papers go to the sheet, each of them, grouped or alone (`single`). Bring it back with [institutions_merge()].

Usage

institutions_clean(
  data,
  affiliations = "C1",
  doi = "DI",
  level = c("confirmed", "all"),
  decisions = NULL,
  min_papers = 5,
  replace = NULL,
  openalex = TRUE,
  cache = .in_default_cache(),
  mailto = NULL,
  output = c("minimal", "all")
)

Arguments

data

A data frame with one row per paper, such as a bibliometrix data frame.

affiliations

The column of author addresses, `;`-separated. Default `"C1"`.

doi

The DOI column. Default `"DI"`.

level

`"confirmed"` (default) or `"all"`; see above.

decisions

With `level = "all"`: the sheet to write, a new path ending in `.xlsx` or `.csv` (an existing file is never replaced). Its columns: `group`, `name`, `institution`, `institution_backup` (a copy of `institution` that [institutions_merge()] matches on), `status` (`single`, `confirmed`, `needs_revision`), `papers`, `openalex_id`, `source` and `example` (an address naming the institution). The model or person checking it adds a column `merge`. The prompt goes to `<sheet>_prompt.txt` and, in an `.xlsx`, to a second tab `prompt`.

min_papers

Only institutions in at least this many papers go into the sheet. Default 5.

replace

Your replacement table for names from address text: a data frame with columns `OLD` and `NEW`, or the path to a `.csv`, `.xlsx` or `.xls` file holding one, as in [keywords_clean()]. It never renames an identified institution; a name renamed to an identified institution's name joins it.

openalex

Ask OpenAlex (`TRUE`, the default)? With `FALSE` every institution comes from the address text.

cache

A folder for OpenAlex's answers, or `NULL` to keep none. Default: a folder in [tools::R_user_dir()]. Delete it to ask again.

mailto

An e-mail address for OpenAlex's polite pool (faster, more reliable). Sent only to OpenAlex, and only when you give it.

output

`"minimal"` (default) returns `data` with `AU_UN` written and nothing else added. `"all"` also adds `AU_UN_ID` (the OpenAlex IDs of each paper's institutions, `;`-separated, `NA` where none) and, when `data` has an `AU_UN` already, `AU_UN_ORIGINAL`.

Value

With `level = "confirmed"`: `data`, same class and rows, with `AU_UN` (each paper's institutions, `"; "`-separated, in author order, `NA` where none) added or replaced; with `output = "all"`, plus the columns above. With `level = "all"`: `data` unchanged, invisibly (the sheet is the result). A message counts the institutions found each way.

Errors

Raises `saqrmisc_bad_input` for a missing or non-character column, a bad `openalex`, `mailto`, `cache` or `min_papers`, `decisions` given with `level = "confirmed"` or missing or existing with `"all"`, and the `replace` errors of [keywords_clean()]; `saqrmisc_missing_package` when `openalex = TRUE` without httr2, or for `.xlsx` without readxl / writexl. Failed OpenAlex requests warn `saqrmisc_openalex_failed`; those papers fall back to their addresses and are asked again on the next run.

References

Priem, J., Piwowar, H., & Orr, R. (2022). OpenAlex: A fully-open index of scholarly works, authors, venues, institutions, and concepts. *arXiv*. doi:10.48550/arXiv.2205.01833

See also

[institutions_merge()], [authors_clean()], [keywords_clean()]

Examples

papers <- data.frame(
  TI = c("Paper one", "Paper two", "Paper three"),
  DI = NA_character_,
  C1 = c("DEPARTMENT OF COMPUTING, UNIVERSITY OF TURKU, TURKU, FINLAND",
         "SCHOOL OF EDUCATION, UNIVERSITY OF EASTERN FINLAND, JOENSUU, FINLAND",
         "UNIVERSITY-OF-TURKU, FINLAND; UNIV EASTERN FINLAND, FINLAND")
)
institutions_clean(papers, openalex = FALSE)
#> institutions: 3 institutions in 3 of 3 papers; links by OpenAlex ID 0, by an address OpenAlex linked 0, by OpenAlex name 0, from address text 4, by your table or sheet 0
#>            TI   DI
#> 1   Paper one <NA>
#> 2   Paper two <NA>
#> 3 Paper three <NA>
#>                                                                     C1
#> 1         DEPARTMENT OF COMPUTING, UNIVERSITY OF TURKU, TURKU, FINLAND
#> 2 SCHOOL OF EDUCATION, UNIVERSITY OF EASTERN FINLAND, JOENSUU, FINLAND
#> 3          UNIVERSITY-OF-TURKU, FINLAND; UNIV EASTERN FINLAND, FINLAND
#>                                       AU_UN
#> 1                       UNIVERSITY OF TURKU
#> 2             UNIVERSITY OF EASTERN FINLAND
#> 3 UNIVERSITY OF TURKU; UNIV EASTERN FINLAND

# Every merge to a sheet, for a person or a model to check.
sheet <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
unchanged <- institutions_clean(papers, level = "all", decisions = sheet, min_papers = 1,
                                openalex = FALSE)
#> file1ef0998c97b.csv: 3 groups and single institutions, 1 confirmed merges and 0 to check, institutions in 1 or more papers. Nothing is merged yet: add a column `merge` (yes or no), then institutions_merge(data, decisions = "file1ef0998c97b.csv"). A prompt for a model is in file1ef0998c97b_prompt.txt.
utils::read.csv(sheet)
#>   group                          name                   institution
#> 1     1           UNIVERSITY OF TURKU           UNIVERSITY-OF-TURKU
#> 2     2          UNIV EASTERN FINLAND          UNIV EASTERN FINLAND
#> 3     3 UNIVERSITY OF EASTERN FINLAND UNIVERSITY OF EASTERN FINLAND
#>              institution_backup    status papers openalex_id        source
#> 1           UNIVERSITY-OF-TURKU confirmed      1          NA same spelling
#> 2          UNIV EASTERN FINLAND    single      1          NA              
#> 3 UNIVERSITY OF EASTERN FINLAND    single      1          NA              
#>                                                                example
#> 1                                         UNIVERSITY-OF-TURKU, FINLAND
#> 2                                        UNIV EASTERN FINLAND, FINLAND
#> 3 SCHOOL OF EDUCATION, UNIVERSITY OF EASTERN FINLAND, JOENSUU, FINLAND
